t: The Saxby AmazonPro CCT LED flush ceiling or wall light is a robust and versatile lighting solution with an integrated microwave sensor. This durable LED bulkhead is ideal for various trade applications, including commercial buildings, public spaces, and bathrooms (Zone 1 rated). It offers selectable colour temperatures (warm white, cool white, daylight) and adjustable wattages (9W, 14W, 18W) for flexible illumination. Installation is straightforward due to its fast-fit hinged gear tray and push-fit connector. With an IP65 rating for water and dust resistance and an IK10 rating for impact protection, it provides reliable performance indoors and outdoors.
